summary: Backend-only test pass for the new Sudoku game. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_sudoku.py (18 tests, 8 test classes) covering catalog, puzzle determinism, solution-leak prevention, daily, /check, /hint, progress upsert idempotency, points awarding per difficulty (5/10/15/25), first-completion gating, Hard achievement + friend Flutter notification, Nightmare achievement, daily_challenge achievement + streak bump, full solvability via /hint+/check, and /games/dailies regression. ALL 18 PASSED in 11s. Solution is never leaked on /puzzle (key absent by default) nor on /daily (explicitly null). Frankie's sudoku_progress + game_completions cleaned up before and after each stateful test (verified post-run: 0 leftover docs).

minor.issue: Sudoku is NOT yet aggregated into /games/dailies (only jigsaw/trivia/wordsearch/memory are). Per the request this was explicitly flagged as a follow-up for the main agent rather than a test failure. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:1177-1199

action_items: (Optional / follow-up) Add a 'sudoku' key to GET /api/games/dailies aggregator response in /app/backend/server.py:1177 to surface today's sudoku alongside jigsaw/trivia/wordsearch/memory.

Consider also adding a sanity check or solver-based hint endpoint that validates uniqueness of the puzzle solution (currently puzzles are guaranteed valid by construction via _transform of a base sudoku, but cell removal is not checked for uniqueness — likely fine for product use, just noting).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py:1430-1445 — /puzzle correctly pops 'solution' when include_solution=False (default). No leak.
/app/backend/server.py:1448-1453 — /daily explicitly returns solution=None; puzzle_id format 'sd:<difficulty>:daily-YYYY-MM-DD' matches spec.

/app/backend/server.py:1479-1515 — Progress upsert uses {$set, $setOnInsert} correctly; uses existing.completed_logged flag for idempotency so re-submitting completion does NOT re-award points or log a duplicate game_completion. Verified.
/app/backend/server.py:1456-1466 — /check returns only {'correct': bool, 'expected_hint': None}; never leaks expected value on incorrect guesses.

Achievement flutter broadcast (server.py:1108-1120) correctly fires for sudoku Hard/Nightmare via ANNOUNCE_DIFFICULTIES set; verified end-to-end with maggie receiving an 'achievement' notification with payload.game_type='sudoku'.
Minor: /puzzle response still includes the 'seed' field which lets clients call /check + /hint freely (intentional per design — server is the only oracle for the solution).
seed_data_creation: None. Tests use frankie + maggie demo accounts; sudoku_progress, game_completions, and achievements for frankie are wiped before/after every stateful test by the cleanup_user_state fixture. Friends list is restored after the friend-flutter test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_sudoku.py -v. Uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env (https://belong-together.preview.emergentagent.com). Cleanup fixture only wipes frankie's sudoku/game_completion/achievement rows for the 4 keys ['hard','nightmare','daily_challenge','first_game'] — no other state is touched. The friend-flutter test temporarily adds maggie to frankie.friends and restores it in `finally`. /games/dailies does NOT yet include 'sudoku' — that's an open follow-up for the main agent, not a regression.
